The 2024 Form 10‑K restates 2023 to exclude the Solventum (Health Care) business as discontinued operations, so the 2023 revenue in the 2024 filing ($24,610 million) is not directly comparable to the 2023 revenue reported in the 2023 Form 10‑K ($32,681 million). I will therefore use the *comparable* 2023 figure from the 2024 income statement when calculating growth to 2024.

Supporting data:

- 2023 total revenue as originally reported in the 2023 Form 10‑K: $32,681 million. [DOC-1]  
- 2024 Form 10‑K consolidated income statement:  
  - 2024 total revenue: $24,575 million.  
  - 2023 total revenue (restated for comparability and excluding discontinued Solventum operations): $24,610 million. [DOC-2]  
- Note that Solventum (Health Care) historical results are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented, explaining the lower, restated 2023 revenue in DOC‑2 compared with DOC‑1. [DOC-3]

Using the comparable basis in DOC‑2:

- 2024 revenue = $24,575 million [DOC-2]  
- 2023 revenue (restated, comparable) = $24,610 million [DOC-2]  

Revenue growth (decline) from 2023 to 2024:

\[
\text{Growth \%} = \frac{24{,}575 - 24{,}610}{24{,}610} \approx -0.14\%
\]

In dollars, this is a decline of:

\[
24{,}575 - 24{,}610 = -35 \text{ million}
\]

ANSWER: -0.14% year-over-year revenue decline (a $35 million decrease) from 2023 to 2024 on a comparable, discontinued-operations-adjusted basis.
